text: {"lessons":["Selling stocks at a loss and then buying all five again soon after suggests I need a clear plan before trading, rather than reacting to discomfort or recent price moves.","A sale does not erase a loss, and a purchase price is not a reason by itself to keep or reject a stock; reassess each holding on its merits.","My account can fall even when I do nothing, and small recent gains do not prove a strategy works; I should judge decisions over time and avoid unnecessary trades."]}
